peopleAlsoAsk.question: Can rabies survive in cold temperatures?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The virus also is readily destroyed by bleach, ultraviolet light, and/ or heat. Live rabies virus will not survive for more than 24 hours in dead animals when temperatures reach 70oF. However, the virus will sur- vive for extended periods at low or freezing temperatures.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: How long does rabies last at room temperature?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The rabies virus is fragile under most normal conditions. It is destroyed within a few minutes at temperatures greater than 122°F, and survives no more than a few hours at room temperature. The virus is no longer infectious once the material containing the virus is dry.
